source_text: I didn't see you at the party yesterday evening
The introduction party was postponed to next month
Come and we dance together till the visitors come
translation: Ija tuzina hamu kuhikya abagenyi niija

source_text: The rain was too much; it had hailstones and caused floods
translation: Enjura egwire muno; omwijurraine gukaleeta n'emiyaga
